The '''Loth-wolf den''' used by [[Loth-wolf|loth-wolves]] was located on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], deep in the [[mountain]]s of the planet's northern hemisphere. It was situated underground, and accessible via a passage underneath one of the planet's omnipresent rock spires. The den was decorated with [[cave]] [[painting]]s done by the ancient people of Lothal, depicting people following Loth-wolves.<ref name="Kindred" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Kindred date">{{RebelsDate|407}}</ref> three wolves led the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebels]] [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Sabine Wren]], [[Garazeb Orrelios]], and [[Ryder Azadi]] to the den, helping them flee the [[Imperial Military|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. When the Empire began bombing the mountain range, the wolves [[Hyperspace tunneling|mystically transported]] the five Rebels from the den to a [[Lothal cliff dwelling|cliff dwelling]] halfway across the planet.<ref name="Kindred" />
